output.subject: We've received your complaint about your personal loan rate
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us about your personal loan. We have received your complaint, and we want you to know it is being taken seriously.

You told us that a loan officer at Fairhaven gave you a written quote of 7.49% for your personal loan, but that the loan closed on 8/29 at 11.99%. You mentioned that you felt pressured to sign at the time because you needed to pay for a roof repair. You estimate that the difference will cost you about $2,140 in additional interest over the life of the loan, and you have asked that the quoted 7.49% rate be honored.

We understand how stressful it can be to manage an urgent home repair alongside a loan that, as you describe it, did not match what you were expecting. We're sorry for the worry and frustration this has caused.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, and we will respond within 10 business days.

Thank you for your patience while we look into this.

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm whether a written 7.49% quote exists and what terms and conditions it carried.
Verify the closing date (8/29, year not stated) and the final rate of 11.99% on the loan documents.
The $2,140 figure is the customer's own estimate; do not adopt or confirm it without checking.
Allegation of pressure to sign is sensitive; review how the closing was conducted before responding on substance.
The loan officer is named in the complaint; the draft deliberately does not name them.
Call note says the case was forwarded to a lending manager; confirm status so replies are not duplicated or contradictory.
Decide whether the customer's request to honor the quoted rate will be addressed in the final response.
